test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of these state/UT government has formulated a policy for the welfare of street children in July 2021 keeping in view the COVID-19 pandemic situation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**'Delhi'**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Delhi government has formulated a policy for the welfare of street children in view of the pandemic situation, which emphasizes the role of various stakeholders in promoting COVID-appropriate behavior and creating awareness about the infection.**
